integrity_note: Exact polynomial proof and two standalone checkers; only a self-review has been performed. External independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Coefficient-marked ordered parameters, not abstract curve-isomorphism classes.
Only characteristic five and the stated smooth normalized Howe family.
No classification of higher Newton slopes or full zeta numerators.
Potential unindexed equivalent earlier computation cannot be excluded.
title: Six-component Hasse divisor and six rank-one parameters for genus-three Howe curves in characteristic five
